coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 18 ground-truth variable items (33%): fp16 precision, matched seeds/configuration across cells, 512-token chunks, a no-lookup condition, a mean-representation condition, and accuracy-based measurements.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses Llama-3-8B with an 8K window instead of Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 with a 4K window; sets k=64 and 32K context instead of 96 selected units and 12K context. Omits the specified GPU hardware, 128 initial tokens, and four representative tokens per 128-token unit. Does not specify the required encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only lookup comparison or the Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and QA task set. Incorrectly substitutes convolutional KV compression for representative-token selection and introduces numerous unrelated factors and metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about full memory lookup improving performance, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or representative-token selection outperforming mean representation.
